subject: how do I create a popup within dataTableOutput

messages.author: 7c50a169f759a7ae
messages.subject: how do I create a popup within dataTableOutput
parts:
I am trying to generate popups using bootstrap popover elements that are generated within a dataframe.

As a starting point I am using: https://gist.github.com/jcheng5/5913297 which works for me when I place a popup within ui.R.

I have modified it so I can generate the same html as as element of dataframe in server.R - this renders correctly.
If I select inspect element it is identical to the ui version except that the event listener has not been attached.

If I view source on my page - the contents of the data table does not appear only 

  <div class="row-fluid">
    <div id="table1" class="shiny-datatable-output"></div>
  </div>

I am thinking that the bootstrap popover initialisation in my header
<script>$(function() { $("[data-toggle='popover']").popover(); })</script>

is not finding the dom elements in the datatable
any suggestions to get round this?

many thanks
